items.source: Uses of JsonPathResultMatchers in org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result
Access to response body assertions using a JsonPath expression to inspect a specific subset of the body.
items.translation: 使用 JsonPath 表达式访问响应体断言，以检查特定子集。

items.source: Configures the current JsonPathResultMatchers instance to verify that the JSON payload is prepended with the given prefix.
items.translation: 配置当前的JsonPathResultMatchers实例，以验证 JSON 负载是否以给定的前缀开头。
